scope: Existing reports and measurements only; no new fits, images, or queries. Tier describes evidence for an eclipse in the blend, not proof that the named target is its host.
conventions: Confirmed: five available gates pass; probable: real eclipses repeat but a check is missing or failed; plausible: one event or two with period untested. Two ambiguous cases do not fit that short plausible description exactly.

cases.repetition_and_period: 117 primary fits; P=2.518978031 d; 116 secondary windows, 98 >3 sigma, conditional on template.
cases.unresolved_check_and_reason: Repeated sharp deficits and a narrow eclipse component favored over tidal harmonics; host localization and secondary/heartbeat interpretation remain uncertain.
